paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Paper constrains QCD axion mass (m_a < 16 meV at 95% CL, KSVZ) from neutron star cooling. The primary result is an upper limit on m_a, but the underlying constraint is on axion-nucleon couplings. For axion-neutron-only and axion-proton-only models they quote |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 and |g_app| < 1.5e-9. These are single-value bounds, not a mass-coupling exclusion curve. Main exclusion plots are m_a vs tan(beta) (DFSZ) and luminosity vs age, not a coupling-vs-mass curve, so no extractable (mass,coupling) data points. Coupling type ambiguous between AxionNeutron, AxionProton, and AxionMass; chose AxionNeutron per hint but with reduced confidence.
